- Armor: 4/3/0/0
- Points: 40
- Shaken: slow [-, -, flee] / Can't use weapons

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |

**Damage Table: Psychic**

| Roll | Effect |

### Gnome Motorcycle

- Equipment: 1x Splintbombgrenade Launcher
- Assault: strength 2/1/1/0 (3+), deflection 2/1/0/0 (5+), damage d6-2, AP 2



#### Splintbombgrenade Launcher

- Range: 2, angle True/True/True/True, damage d6, AP 2
- **Area**: Choose one hex within range. If fired from 3 models it has Area(4+), if fired from 2 models it has Area(5+), if fired by 1 model it has Area(6+)

## Gnome Helicopter (4×)

- Size: Large
- Models: 1x Gnome Helicopter
- Type: Bio Crew, Helicopter, Flying
- Armor: 0/0/0/0
- Points: 80
- Shaken: still [-, -, -] / Can't use weapons

- **Fire Order**: Drop weapon is used with Throw(d) orders. All other weapons (relevant if given side weapons) fires, loads and aim simultaneously
- **Quick fix**: [1, self, 1st Healing]

**Damage Table: Regular**

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
| 1-3 | +1 to future damage |
| 4-5 | as below, shaken |
| 6-8 | +3 to future damage, shaken |
| 9 | Destroy unit |

**Damage Table: Crew**

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
- As Regular damage table


### Gnome Helicopter

- Equipment: 1x Acidic Napalm Bomb, 1x Helicopter Gatling Gun
- Assault: strength 1/0/0/0 (3+), deflection 0/0/0/0 (), damage d6-2, AP 2

- **To Hit**: Good Shot; Excellent Shot. Replaces the good shot bonus while the helicopter hovers still in the air


#### Acidic Napalm Bomb

- Range: 2, angle True/True/True/True, damage n.a, AP 0
- **Area**: Choose a hex within normal range: Area(4+): minor acid and any unit hit at least one is set on fire (note, you inflict one minor acid per hit on the unit, but maximum one fire)
- **Limited Ammo**: [2]

#### Helicopter Gatling Gun

- Range: 3, angle True/False/False/False, damage d6-1, AP 6
- **Multiple Shots**: Fire once at all enemy units within range and within angle of fire
- **Focus Fire**: If aim, instead use focus fire, roll 6 dice at same unit
- **Bonus**: Bullet storm: If not using aim, a natural 6 on to-hit die is considered a hit regardless of to-hit modifiers
